answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. The lagoon holds work receipts rather than names, so the ledge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the island of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
